title: Cooking Lab Build Control queue instruction
description: The single active unattended instruction. It may only activate a tracked prompt file under build-control/prompts/. It never carries commands, arguments or scripts of its own.

instruction_id.description: Unique, stable identifier. Never reuse an id for a different prompt or base commit; the runner refuses that as a duplicate-execution hazard.

prompt_path.description: Repository-relative, forward-slashed path to a tracked Markdown prompt. Absolute paths, '..' traversal, symlinks and any path outside build-control/prompts/ are rejected.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the prompt's git blob content (git cat-file blob <commit>:<prompt_path>), not of the checked-out file. Blob content is machine-independent; working-tree bytes are not, because core.autocrlf is enabled on this machine.

expected_base_commit.description: Full SHA of commit A: the commit that published this exact prompt revision. The commit that activates this queue file must have A as its first parent.

milestone.description: Milestone label, e.g. 'M1', or 'RUNNER' for infrastructure self-tests.

scope.description: Short human-readable description of the bounded work. Documentation for the audit trail; the runner does not act on it.

allow_unattended.description: Must be exactly true for the runner to act. false (or an absent queue file) means there is no pending executable instruction.

notes.description: Optional free text for the audit trail. Never interpreted or executed.
